import argparse


def health_check(as_json: bool = False) -> int:
    print("  Pipeline Health Report")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="health monitor")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    return health_check(as_json=args.json)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
